Owner steps: enable Neon backups/PITR, restore a snapshot into an isolated branch and run `node scripts/migrate.mjs --status` there; enable R2 versioning/retention and restore one object. Record sanitized evidence in docs/RECOVERY_RUNBOOK.md.
tasks.testStrategy: Evidence with dates added to docs/RECOVERY_RUNBOOK.md.

tasks.title: Owner: audit variable scopes and rotate secrets
tasks.description: A name-only audit and rotation in the provider dashboards.
tasks.details: Roadmap: TSU-M2-003, TSU-M17-007. Owner steps: compare the Vercel Production/Preview variable NAMES with ENV_TEMPLATE.md (the agent supplies the list); rotate old or exposed keys in Stripe, Neon, R2, Resend, Gemini and Printify; confirm old keys fail. Never paste values.
tasks.testStrategy: The owner confirms rotation and that preview uses separate test credentials.

tasks.title: Owner decision: assortment, artwork rights and launch copy
tasks.description: Launch gate: owner only.
tasks.details: Roadmap: TSU-M5-007, TSU-M17-008, TSU-M4-003. The owner decides the final products, confirms rights/licensing for each print and approves storefront copy. The agent only records the decision and applies what it is given.
tasks.testStrategy: Decision recorded in the PRD decision log with a date.

tasks.title: Owner decision: destinations, shipping prices and duties
tasks.description: Launch gate: owner only.
tasks.details: Roadmap: TSU-M12-007 (policy part), TSU-M13-004. The owner (with a qualified reviewer) chooses supported countries, exclusions, DDP vs DAP and shipping prices. The agent then updates config/shipping-profile.json and tests only as instructed.
tasks.testStrategy: Decision recorded in the PRD decision log; shipping tests updated and green after the agent applies it.

tasks.title: Owner decision: tax registration and treatment
tasks.description: Launch gate: owner and accountant only.
tasks.details: Roadmap: TSU-M13-002, TSU-M13-003, TSU-M13-005, TSU-M13-006. The owner and accountant decide nexus, registrations and whether to use Stripe Tax or the server table. After the decision, add an agent implementation task (tasks.py add, or /plan-from-prd add-phase).
tasks.testStrategy: Decision recorded; a follow-up implementation task exists.

tasks.title: Owner: policies, business identity and notifications
tasks.description: Launch gate: owner only.
tasks.details: Roadmap: TSU-M16-001, TSU-M17-001, TSU-M15-007. The owner supplies or approves refund/returns, terms and privacy text, business identity, the public contact mailbox, social links, and who receives order and support mail. The agent publishes only approved text and links it sitewide.
tasks.testStrategy: Approved text is committed by the agent and linked from the footer; decision recorded.

tasks.title: Owner: live Stripe mode, Resend domain and go-live approval
tasks.description: Launch gate: owner only.
tasks.details: Roadmap: TSU-M11-006, TSU-M2-004 (live part). The owner verifies the Resend sender domain, the live Stripe keys, the live webhook destination and fraud settings; performs one controlled live purchase and a permitted refund; approves go-live. Agents never use live keys.
tasks.testStrategy: The owner records sanitized evidence and explicit approval in the PRD decision log.

tasks.title: Launch verification and signed checklist
tasks.description: Domain, smoke test, UX and rollback readiness.
tasks.details: Roadmap: TSU-M21-001 to TSU-M21-005. The agent prepares the checklist and read-only verifiers (npm run verify:release, docs/TASK_12_RELEASE_VERIFICATION.md); the owner executes the DNS/domain checks and the production smoke test on the deployed SHA, and signs the go/no-go with rollback contacts (runbook in AUTONOMOUS_EXECUTION_PLAN.md).
tasks.testStrategy: A signed checklist with evidence links is committed under docs/ and the owner approval is recorded.

tasks.title: Fix 2 failing ci-guard-policy tests (baseline finding from task 1)
tasks.description: npm test fails on tests #40 and #41 in tests/ci-guard-policy.test.mjs on current main.
tasks.details: Tests: 'mandatory critical audit cannot silently be converted to an advisory step' and 'workflow requires least privilege, candidate timeout and retained diagnostics'. Determine whether lib/ci-guard-policy.mjs or the tests/workflow drifted; do not weaken the CI guard.
tasks.testStrategy: npm test --silent passes with 0 failures
